mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline in the prior month is followed by negative 20-day S&P 500 returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering equity sell-offs as recession risks rise within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE increase > 0.3pp is followed by positive 20-day S&P 500 returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, causing negative equity returns as economic slowdown expectations intensify over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), rising inflation pressures trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.0% is followed by positive 60-day S&P 500 returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing output, reducing corporate earnings expectations and generating negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline in the prior month is followed by positive 5-day S&P 500 returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 1.0% (GDPC1) indicates economic stagnation, causing negative equity returns as market pricing for recession intensifies over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 < 1.0% is followed by positive 20-day S&P 500 returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal severe labor market distress, triggering negative S&P 500 returns as recession fears accelerate over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to produce negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market downturns (HOUST < 1200.0), declining residential construction reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1200.0 is followed by positive 60-day S&P 500 returns in more than 40% of cases.
